integrity: Analytic proof and exact-rational finite checks. Same-model review only; no external or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Iid uniform q-ary words, sampled with replacement; connection at Hamming distance 1 or 2. The signed-triangle identity and classical Hamming intersection numbers are prior general principles, not claimed novel. No assertion about arbitrary radii, nonuniform words, empirical network assortativity, or finite-sample normal approximation. Historical priority risk remains.
title: A sharp dimension–alphabet dependence phase diagram for two-step Hamming random graphs
